title: Florida House, District 12
what_it_does: Represents District 12 in the Florida House of Representatives; votes on state laws and the state budget.
decided_note: Open seat: Republican Rep. Wyman Duggan is term-limited. One candidate per party qualified, so there was no Aug. 18 primary; the race is decided Nov. 3.
verified_ballot_note: News4JAX's 2026 voter guide for HD 12 reports Republican Terrance Freeman and Democrat Benjamin Sandlin as the only candidates, with no primary because each party had one candidate (https://www.news4jax.com/voters-guide/2026/07/31/2026-voters-guide-florida-house-district-12/). Research limitation: every WebFetch (Ballotpedia, Wikipedia, Division of Elections, county SOEs, news sites) was blocked and the search budget was capped, so this roster comes only from search-result snippets and should be re-verified against the county Supervisor of Elections sample ballot.
